description: Double-strand roller-chain sprocket per ISO 606 / DIN 8187: two in-phase tooth discs (ISO 606 §8.2 tooth form) one transverse pitch pt apart, joined by an intermediate groove cylinder that clears the chain's inner link plates; one-sided hub boss on medium/hard, center bore, DIN 6885A keyway on hard. Chain row sampled jointly as (pitch, roller, tooth width, transverse pitch).
source: norelem 22253 datasheet (sprockets duplex 5/8" x 3/8" DIN ISO 606) — see NOTES.md for the symbol mapping; ISO 606 Table 1 + §8.2 tooth equations; pt column per Renold DIN 8187 duplex tables (10B-2 confirmed by norelem B2 = 25,5); DIN 6885-1 Form A key seats
